scope: CodeOJ limited contest registration; source review plus private Redis 6.2.24 / Spring / H2 probes

findings.title: Late older reconciliation failure pauses a newer successful reconciliation
Remaining-capacity UI counts pending reservations as remaining places

probeInterpretation: Two probes assert that defects are reproducible; their successful assertions do not mean business correctness. The third probe validates partial-reserve + cancel + recovery + late-confirm safety.
